steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and use the single-stage lot-award configuration.
Apply the first offered RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified mapped product and set its requested quantity.
Choose the required delivery location for the product row.
Verify that the RFQ pricing sheet rendered the expected product and vendor columns.
Use the product's Invite Vendor action to add every vendor mapped to the product.
Verify that the invitation action added participants to the event.
Verify that publication reached a real event project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list to inspect the invited audience.
Verify that the published stage contains the invited participants.
